card.title: Pinned order
card.description: Rules that keep one mod after another, whatever smart sort or a save does.
card.inactiveTitle: Not enabled on this server: {{mods}}. The rule is kept and applies again once they are.
card.deleteDesc: The rule “{{after}} always loads after {{before}}” is deleted. Smart sort and saves stop keeping that order.
card.deleteFailedTitle: The rule could not be deleted
card.deleteFailedFallback: Something went wrong while deleting the rule.
card.emptyDesc: Open a mod's menu on the Load order list and pick “Always load after…” or “Always load before…”. Applying a suggested conflict winner pins one too.
card.loadFailed: The pinned order could not be loaded.
card.filterAria: Filter pinned rules by mod name or ID
card.noPermission: Your role does not have permission to manage mods.

dialog.descAfter: Pick the mod it must follow. Smart sort and every save keep this order.
dialog.descBefore: Pick the mod it must come before. Smart sort and every save keep this order.
dialog.truncated: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}}. Type to narrow the list.
dialog.notePlaceholder: Why this order? Other admins see it.
dialog.replaceDesc: A pinned rule keeps {{before}} after {{after}}. Pinning this order replaces that rule.

errors.cycleTitle_one: This would make a loop of {{count}} mod: {{mods}}
errors.cycleTitle_other: This would make a loop of {{count}} mods: {{mods}}
errors.cycleTitleUnknown: This would make a loop with other rules or required mods.
errors.cycleHint: No order can satisfy a loop. Delete one of the pinned rules in it first, or pin the other way round.
errors.limit: You can keep at most {{max}} pinned rules. Delete one first.
errors.limitUnknown: You have reached the most pinned rules the panel keeps. Delete one first.
errors.addFailed: The order could not be pinned.

suggestion.suggested: Suggested: {{winner}} should load last and win
suggestion.pinnedNotSorted: Pinned. Sort the load order to apply it.
suggestion.chipSuggestTitle: The panel suggests {{winner}} should load last and win.
suggestion.chipAsSuggestedTitle: {{winner}} already wins, as the panel suggests.
suggestion.appliedDesc: {{winner}} now always loads after {{loser}}. Sort the load order to apply it.
suggestion.failedTitle: The suggestion could not be applied
suggestion.noPermission: Your role does not have permission to manage mods.

reason.rule: A pinned rule already says so.
reason.requiresOther: {{winner}} requires {{loser}}, so it is meant to override it.
reason.declaresLoadAfter: {{winner}} asks in its mod.info to load after {{loser}}.
reason.translation: {{winner}} is a translation: it should load after what it translates.
reason.smallOverride_one: {{winner}} is a small mod ({{count}} file) and {{conflicting}} of its files replace files of {{loser}} ({{otherFiles}} files): a deliberate override.
reason.smallOverride_other: {{winner}} is a small mod ({{count}} files) and {{conflicting}} of its files replace files of {{loser}} ({{otherFiles}} files): a deliberate override.
reason.sameWorkshopItem: Both come from the same Workshop item, whose page lists {{winner}} after {{loser}}.

bar.text_one: {{count}} suggested winner is high confidence and not applied yet.
bar.text_other: {{count}} suggested winners are high confidence and not applied yet.
bar.confirmDesc: Each one becomes a pinned rule: the winner always loads after the other mod. Nothing moves until you sort and save the load order.
bar.doneDesc: Sort the load order to apply them.
bar.noPermission: Your role does not have permission to manage mods.

autofix.title: Fix everything
autofix.description: Everything the panel can fix in one go. Untick what you don't want; nothing changes until you apply.
autofix.scanning: The last conflict scan is out of date: scanning again first…
autofix.settledHint: A conflict is settled once the mod the panel suggests wins it, or one of its two mods is disabled.
autofix.sectionFixesHint: These only add what is missing to the server ini.
autofix.sectionRulesHint: Each becomes a pinned rule: the winner always loads after the other mod.
autofix.sectionPlanHint: Smart sort with the rules above, saved like Save order.
autofix.sectionRemovalsHint: These take something out of the server ini, so none is ticked. Tick only what you want gone.
autofix.sectionReviewHint: Higher-impact conflicts the panel is not sure about. Open them in the Conflicts list to pick a winner.
autofix.planReasonMoves: Mods that move: {{count}}. Requirements, pinned rules and groups decide where.
autofix.planReasonNone: The order already follows every rule.
autofix.variantReason: A variant of {{others}} from the same Workshop item: they share files, so only one should be enabled.
autofix.reviewNoSuggestion: Nothing says which of the two should win.
autofix.nothing: Nothing to fix: the mod list is healthy and every higher-impact conflict is settled.
autofix.snapshotStep: Keeping the current mod list for Undo
autofix.doneDesc: Applied: {{applied}}. Already solved: {{skipped}}. Mods moved: {{moved}}. A new conflict scan is running.
autofix.failedDesc: {{message}} Steps applied before it: {{applied}}. Undo puts everything back.
autofix.undoneDesc: Mods=, WorkshopItems= and Map= are back as they were, and the rules it pinned are gone.
autofix.confirmRemovals: Fix everything will also take these out of the server ini. Undo puts them back, and a backup of the ini is made first.
